summary: Comprehensive testing of SB Pay application completed. Backend APIs working at 90.5% success rate, frontend fully functional with excellent UI/UX implementation. All core features tested including authentication, multi-currency wallets, transfers, deposits via Stripe, bill payments, transaction history, and admin dashboard.

minor_issues.issue: Returns 400 for existing users instead of more specific error handling
minor_issues.impact: User experience could be improved with better error messages

design_observations.observation: Excellent implementation with proper SB Pay branding, orange color scheme (#E87E04), and professional UI components
Complete with SB logo, app store badges, feature cards, and proper French localization
Multi-currency wallets (EUR, USD, XOF) properly displayed with real-time balances
All forms (transfer, deposit, bills) have proper validation and user feedback

passed_tests: Landing page with SB logo and app store badges
Bill payment system with multiple bill types
Admin dashboard with user and transaction stats
Proper authentication protection on admin routes
